description: Mega Charizard X closer backed by a Cramorant lead and Hippowdon safe swap in the Mega Great League. A fun anti-Ninetales team — Mega Charizard X's fire/dragon typing double-resists both Weather Ball Fire and Energy Ball, hard-walling Kanto and Shadow Kanto Ninetales.
performanceNotes: Mega Charizard X double resists Weather Ball Fire and Energy Ball, dominating Ninetales matchups
Extremely frail Mega Charizard X, so shield advantage from Cramorant/Hippowdon is key to enabling it

sources.author: HomeSliceHenry
sources.videoTitle: MEGA CHARIZARD X *DESTROYS NINETALES* in the Mega Great League!

description: Melmetal lead with Mega Sableye as the safe swap and a Moonblast Florges in the back, played in open Great League. Melmetal's buffed Double Iron Bash + Dynamic Punch spam carries the team, with Mega Sableye providing a bulky Foul Play/Return response and Florges cleaning up.
performanceNotes: Melmetal is so strong it frequently 2v3s, often without needing the third Pokemon
Double Iron Bash (buffed to 70/35) acts as a Leaf Blade clone alongside 90/45 Dynamic Punch for the most efficient moveset in the game
Mega Sableye running Return hits harder than usual and landed clutch damage in several games; Florges' cheaper Moon Blast (65) offers helpful pacing

description: Mega Sableye lead abuses Drain Punch defense boosts to become nearly unkillable, with Lickilicky as a bulky pivot and Shadow Kanto Ninetales as the energy-hungry closer. The team wins by stacking defense on Sableye and overwhelming with Ninetales' Weather Ball/Energy Ball pressure.
performanceNotes: Mega Sableye reaches +4 defense via triple-resisted Drain Punch and becomes effectively unkillable
Shadow Kanto Ninetales survives despite everyone team-building into it, closing multiple games
Went positive across most showcased matches (wins in games 1, 2, and 4)

sources.author: HomeSliceHenry
sources.videoTitle: Mega Sableye is *UNREAL* in the Mega Great League!

description: Mimikyu lead, three-charge-move Mega Malamar (played at Mega Level 3 to stay under 1500 CP) as the mid-game pivot, and Tinkaton as the closer. Mega Malamar overfarms behind Mimikyu's disguise then fires off Psybeam Plus/Superpower/Foul Play, while Tinkaton uses Bulldoze debuffs to enable Gigaton Hammer KOs.
performanceNotes: Psybeam Plus (72 damage for 45 energy at Mega Level 3) one-shots/over-pressures Psychic-weak targets like Annihilape and Shadow Kanto Ninetales
Team is strong into Annihilape and K9 lines, and Mimikyu dominates Altaria
Struggles against Mega Sableye running Drain Punch, which breaks the disguise while boosting its own defense
